title: Power Under Control: Food, Sex & Self-Mastery

sense.text:
This was read on the morning the news came of Israel and America, the iron fist and the hammer of the earth, attacking Iran. When the bishops and the deacons bring out the prophecies, they bring them out to warn us and to show us the time we are in, so that we can do a self-assessment, get our spirits in tune with the scriptures, and be prepared as a bride adorned for the bridegroom in that day.

“The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward”. The Lord knows what he made. He knows the internal struggles and the external struggles, and the world of sin built around us to keep us locked in a sinful cycle. God is patient towards us; he is waiting for us to get ourselves together.

“Not willing that any should perish”. Some say the Lord is the reason they fell away, or that Satan made them do it. No. The Lord does not want any of us to perish. He wants every one of the elect to come to repentance: “that all should come to repentance.”

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”: the second return of Christ comes when we are unaware, when we least expect it. You might look at the news and think it is tomorrow. It might be five years from now, ten, or fifteen. It is designed that way on purpose, to keep us on our game at all times: to be in the fear of the Lord all the day long, not a temporary fear that comes and goes with circumstances, but a way of living.

“The heavens shall pass away with a great noise”: heavens are kingdoms, and what has the power to make kingdoms pass away is the ICBM missile. “The elements shall melt with fervent heat”: the elements of the periodic table, copper, iron, zinc, the metals. Where is that power but in a nuclear missile, an atom bomb, Satan 2, Poseidon? These vessels of mass destruction the Lord had created by these scientists in order to bring destruction on America and Israel and the surrounding nations, all that put their hand to our people. Everybody is going to feel the wrath of God’s hand.

“The earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.” And still people take this Bible as a game, as a joke: brothers still slinging, gang banging, having sex outside of marriage, smoking, getting high, clubbing; sisters twerking on cop cars, fighting, caught up in the Instagram model world. Our people are not watching and praying like Christ wants us to. There has to be a paradigm shift. The Bible is the only thing that shall influence us.

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved”: your clubs, the TVs, the radio stations, everything you have, everything you experience and partake in is going to be dissolved. “What manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”? That is the question, now that Iran, Israel and America are in rumors of war, and this is just the beginning.

You cannot predict when the next attack will come, or how Israel or Iran will respond. We have no control over the politics, the media or these world leaders. But one thing the Lord gave us control over is our vessel, our mind, and that is what we have to possess and bring to self-mastery. With the bishops, the deacons and the captains giving us this daily bread every week to prepare us, we have to level up: bring ourselves to self-control, mastery and perfection, and regain our power, because the time is near and the time is at hand.

“Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth”. The first order given to man was marriage: to procreate, to bring forth seed and children upon the earth and populate it. This verse deals with sex, the procreation of life.

Then the very next verse deals with nourishment: “I have given you every herb bearing seed”, and “to you it shall be for meat.” One deals with procreation, the other with nourishing the life God placed on this earth. Sex is meant for procreation and sustaining life, and food is meant for nourishing that life.

Neither of the two is evil in itself. You need food for survival, and you need sex for survival. It is the overindulgence, when you enter the realm of losing self-control over sex or over food, that it becomes evil. That is why food and sex, the two biggest factors from the beginning, are the subject of self-mastery.

precepts.why:
“Take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting”. Surfeiting is excess, an excessive amount: an uncomfortably full feeling from excessive eating or drinking. It means to overindulge, to eat excessively, to go beyond your limits of discipline, whether it is food, drink or sex.

“Take heed to yourselves”: to your individual self. It is a self-examination. Your hearts are your minds; notice how Christ always deals with the mind, and how in the wilderness Satan attacked the mind first. “Overcharged” means going over the limit, like being overcharged past the price on the tag. The body is a vehicle God placed our spirit and soul in, and like a car there is a limit to the gas, the washer fluid and the engine oil you can put in. Go over it and things start breaking down. There are instructions given to this vehicle so we keep it within its limit.

“And drunkenness”: you can drink, but in moderation. Go over that blood alcohol level and you activate demons; you tap into the spiritual realm and give Satan the opportunity to access your vessel. That is why they call it wine and spirits: too much of it puts spirits on you. The same goes for any excess, even working out in the gym to excess; spirits can attach. Everything has to be done in moderation.

“And cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares”: overindulgence in food, drink, sex and the cares of life is how the day of Christ’s coming catches us unaware.

sense.text: Food and sex look like two separate things, but they are closely related when it comes to our body: one is the procreation of life and the other the nourishing of that life. Paul speaks of “the enemies of the cross of Christ”, those in opposition to the gospel: the scribes, the Pharisees and the wicked Israelites. They knew Christ. They could not resist his wisdom, and they saw miracles no man could do. But they loved the position Rome placed them in, the accolades, the greetings in the marketplace, the authority. And what comes with that position? Food and sex.

“Whose God is their belly”. There are people who make their belly their god: nourishing their flesh, their food consumption, the excess. The Pharisees were committing adultery through the time of Babylon, Greece and Rome, creeping into women’s houses as they did in Susanna and exploiting the women. Eli’s sons sat at the temple and, because of their position and status, exploited the women, because position, status and power get money, power and respect, and they used it to their advantage. Their god went into their food, into their excess, into their sex.

“Whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.” An earthly person cares about the things of the earth: when am I going to eat, the things that please the eyes and the flesh. When we overindulge outside of the guidelines God gave us, we step out of the realm of God and of discipline into the realm of Satan. That is why God gave us a law.

precepts.why:
“For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding”. Discipline is a holy spirit. There is a cap and a limitation. The person who overindulges in food, who cannot stop eating, is worshipping himself, because God says to eat in moderation and to eat what is nourishing; don’t eat just to eat. People followed Christ just for the food, because their god was their belly, while Christ’s meat was to do the will of the Father.

Discipline has to be practiced. You wonder why you cannot obtain discipline: it is because you do not have the Holy Spirit. There is a level of the Holy Spirit given to you because you know your nationality, but there are levels to accessing it and gaining power through it. The disciples reached the level where they could do miracles. Complete access to the Holy Spirit comes through disciplining our food intake and our sex outtake, because those two are the stumbling blocks that keep us from moving forward.

“Be not excessive toward any; and without discretion do nothing.” Don’t be excessive in anything. You may say, but I’m hungry. Ask yourself why you are eating. Is it for nourishment and the proper nutrients, or because it looks good, smells good, tastes good, sounds good? Are outside entities programming you, catering to the lust of the flesh through the tunnels of your eyes and your ears? Did you eat five minutes ago and now you need a snack?

Some are excessive even in sex: the nymphomaniac, who wants sex all the time. Sex was created for procreation; outside of procreation it becomes a pleasure. And how much pleasure until there is a complete fulfillment of the body? There is no end to it. It is the same as smoking weed: you get high, you come down, you smoke to get high again. There is no fulfillment in weed, in alcohol, in the excess of sex, or in overeating.

The only fulfillment is in disciplining your spirit and keeping God’s commandments. Once you go outside the realm of discipline you are catering to the realm of Satan, and you open yourself up to be a target and to be controlled at any level.

“For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly”. This is the wicked of our people. They do not serve Christ; they serve their fleshly pleasures and lust. Let me get over on this person, defraud this person, steal from this person, so I can fill my own belly. Like Biggie with the Ten Crack Commandments: I’m only selling crack to feed my family. He did not serve the Lord Jesus Christ; he served his own belly, and his stomach became his god.

You can see it. Your vessel is an indicator of who you serve. By the way you look, the way you carry yourself, your conduct, your speech and your character, we can tell who your master is. People will get mad, but if you are grotesquely overweight, outside the realm of a natural diet, then you are your god. You say you don’t celebrate birthdays, the highest satanic celebration of oneself, but if you cannot control your food intake, your god is your belly and you are your own god just the same.

The good thing is that you can control it, just like you control whether you celebrate birthdays or not. God looks at things differently than we do, so we have to reframe our mindset into the mindset of Christ and the Father.

“All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient”. Paul was speaking to the Corinthians about food offered to idols and sold in the shambles. If the food is clean by the dietary law of Leviticus 11 and Deuteronomy 14, it is lawful whether it was offered to idols or not, since an idol is nothing. But it is not expedient, not profitable, if it offends my brother who lacks that knowledge; that would not be brotherly love and charity. “I will not be brought under the power of any.”

“Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats”: food is for nourishment, and the belly was made for food to nourish the life created on this earth. “But God shall destroy both it and them”: you argue over food, but God is going to destroy both the meats and the one consuming them.

Then Paul moves straight to fornication, because in the previous chapter a man had taken his father’s wife: “Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.” He goes from food to sex because the two are correlated; both deal with self-control over your vessel. Your body was created as a vessel of righteousness, to be used for the master’s work.

sense.text: “Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites.” It is not only talking about sex. Your appetite can be anything you overindulge in: food, sex, working out, TV and entertainment, sports, scrolling. But food and sex are one and the same, and if we can get control over our food intake and our sex outtake, we can get control of anything in our life and reprogram our vessel to do whatever the Lord commands. It is about mastery over our vessel.

“If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her”: not what you need, but what you desire. There are wants and there are needs. Sex for procreation is a need, and where you burn, husband and wife do benevolence to each other. When it is not needed: study, pray, fast. That is how you discipline yourself. With food: I’m hungry, I eat and nourish my body, and I’m not hungry anymore. Then ask what foods give me the energy to think, to function, to be productive and push in this work. Food is fuel to move you forward.

“She will make thee a laughingstock”. They will say, I can’t listen to a fat prophet. You have brothers powerful on the streets, cutting people up, bad to the bone teachers, and people look at them and say, brother, I can’t listen to you, because you don’t even listen to you. Satan tells you that you are hungry. Satan tells you to eat that McDonald’s, that Burger King, that candy, to make you sickly so you cannot do the work. That is why some are sick every Sabbath: they are not feeding the body vitamins, fibers and nutrients to possess the vessel, but feeding the lust of the flesh.

Now you are a laughingstock. Look at that fat dude, Big Yellow; brothers take pictures every time you put food in your mouth. He can’t even control himself, but he’s telling me what to do. An Edomite woman who looked like a whale once interjected herself into a conversation about food to give advice, and the answer was: I can’t listen to you, because what you tell me doesn’t reflect what you do in your life. People will not listen to you when you are operating outside the realm of discipline.

“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world.” All these things are of the world, and the world is predominantly America. America is the kingdom of sin, specifically designed and created against us, in complete opposition to us, to cater to the flesh and get you to indulge. It was made to test you: to make you or break you, to forge you or destroy you. Only the strong, spiritually, mentally and physically, will survive this kingdom.

“If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.” Everything catered to us in entertainment, when we are bored and idle, is love of the world. Scrolling is love of the world. Porn is love of the world. Instagram models are love of the world. Clubbing is love of the world.

“The lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father”. Satan was given power over this world, and he tries to get you to operate outside of your purpose. Take Serena Williams: why is she put before our eyes over her sister Venus, and pictured at that angle? Brothers like the thick, voluptuous, curvy shape; it caters to the eyes and the flesh, the appetite. Hollywood and the magazines flash it before us because it is of the world. But it may look good outwardly and not have good ingredients. She was an athlete, naturally thick, not fat; our women are naturally voluptuous and thick, and you can be fit and thick. Yet she altered herself to appeal to society. Read the label on the back of a woman like that: negative thoughts, self-hate, low self-esteem, identity confusion, fear of rejection, people pleasing, zero confidence; ingredients of unresolved trauma, social media comparison, past rejection. That is not nourishing to a marriage.

The Instagram and TikTok models look appealing to the eyes, but men do not marry women like that. In her unrepented stage she cannot raise children, cannot be a pillar of rest, cannot be a teacher and mother to her daughters. Esau keeps pushing the goalpost: in the 90s Buffy the Body was the biggest, and now the butt keeps getting bigger, from a Coke bottle to a shape you could balance a whole table on. That is what lust does: it pushes the woman excessively over her bodily limits until she alters her vessel to please you.

Food works the same way. McDonald’s presentation, the McFlurry, the smell as you drive by, the big arch like the big butt: these are advertising triggers, tunnels through your senses to possess your vessel. Sex sells and food sells; they control the world around us. A burger is meat and a bun, yet a Big Mac has over fifty ingredients, and that one meal is 1,300 to 1,600 calories and still not fulfilling, with chemicals put in it to keep you eating. A Dunkin Donuts egg, turkey sausage and cheese croissant is 600 calories at the start of the day. The Whopper is all presentation, the work of master psychologists, full of what the body cannot break down, and America is the fattest country in the world. In Japan the same McDonald’s was real food with simple ingredients; come back here and it tastes like cardboard. That is the deception of Babylon.

The Popeyes fried chicken, the butter biscuit at 600 calories soaked in butter, the spicy chicken sandwich that had people lining up around the block until somebody was killed over chicken: full of MSG. The white man studied our bodies in medical experiments, how chemicals fire dopamine and the reward centers in the brain, and that is how Esau knows what to put in food to gain control over your senses. It is a power struggle over the five senses God made. Even Chick-fil-A, the Christian company closed on Sunday, is Satan as an angel of light, with fifty-five ingredients in one sandwich.

The Popeyes, Burger Kings and McDonald’s are put in black neighborhoods, not Edomite neighborhoods. You know it is not good for you and you still indulge: that shows a lack of discipline and of control over your vessel and your thoughts, and a man is nothing without discipline. The Lord is using the leadership, through Captain Shem’s yellow and red, to make the nation healthy, so that a sister at camp said she had never seen black men so fit; we need the brothers fit and in the street to teach. Working out is only ten or twenty percent; about eighty percent of losing weight is diet, and that is where the discipline comes in. The itis does not exist; it is the food making you sleepy. Real food gives energy and alertness. Structuring the day in an eating window and a calorie deficit carries over into every part of life: study habits, how you deal with lust and sex, and how you deal with people.

Now look at healthy food: no one salivates, because it does not cater to the lust. Nobody wakes up lusting for avocado or carrots, nobody is lusting at the blueberries. Yet it is beautiful in its natural essence, in the colors God made, with the iron, zinc, calcium and vitamins of the earth. We were made from the dust of the ground, so we must put the earthly elements back into our vessel. Just so, the daughters of Sarah in modesty, with healthy colors: a nutritional, spiritual, godly woman who encourages, uplifts, teaches the children, speaks scripture and rises early like Proverbs 31. Quiet and submissive, supportive, respectful, humble, kind, wise, modest, shamefaced, virtuous, diligent, a teacher of good things. Tobias took not his sister for lust; you are not to lust after the food, and you are not to lust after those women. You need an Israelite woman for nourishment.

We have a deeply unhealthy relationship with food, looking to it for affirmation, to feel good and safe, the same comfort people go after in sex. It is the same correlation, and if you cannot control it, it is sin. If you are overweight, you are in sin: gluttony, overindulging. And you cannot flee from something that is in your refrigerator. The brain does not distinguish the two; the same reward centers fire for the food that pleases the flesh and for sex.

“Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent”. We use the word flee for lust, and the same applies to food: you cannot flee if it is in your refrigerator. Flee from that refrigerator, flee from the unhealthy foods. “For if thou comest too near it, it will bite thee”, it will bite you and destroy you. That is why many brothers have health issues, cannot make it to the Sabbath, and are in the hospital every week. You need a healthy vessel to do the work productively.

“My son, prove thy soul in thy life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that unto it.” See what is evil for your soul, and do not give it that. From verse 27 down to 30 the whole analogy is literally food, but it is spiritual too. Just as you see which foods are evil for you, which make you sick and unhealthy, see what things are evil for your spirit and will make you mentally unhealthy. Just as you say, I cannot eat these foods on my diet, you say, I cannot watch this show; Spartacus may be a good show, but it is full of sex scenes.

“For all things are not profitable for all men, neither hath every soul pleasure in every thing.” A fat brother’s diet is different from the diet of a brother who is already lean; it is a totally different structure. Not everything is profitable for everyone.

“Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats”. Don’t be insatiable, without any control. Don’t overdo it. Don’t eat excessively.

They call it food porn: pictures of food that make you feel hunger pangs when you were not hungry, firing the pleasure and reward centers of the brain with dopamine. Pornography is a battle for most brothers, and sisters too though they are not as upfront, but food is also pornography, because the brain does not separate the two: both are nourishment, one nourishing the marriage and the other the flesh. Pick healthier food porn, fruit instead of grease, and the same holds with sex: you can have that same pleasure the healthy way, with your wife. There is a healthy pleasure and an unhealthy pleasure.
“For excess of meats bringeth sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler.” Excess of meats and surfeiting is overindulging beyond the limits of human consumption, and it brings sickness.

This is not a diet class. We went to Genesis because food and sex are the two biggest factors in the world: one deals with procreation and the other with nourishing. “Abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul”: abstain from those temptations, whether it is food, porn, or sexual desire outside of marriage.

It is that serious. With 100 calories left for the day and a 240-calorie cookie in front of you, there is a battle inside: I want that cookie, I need that cookie, just one bite. Fasting for two days on a Sabbath in New York, they put the basket of chips right in front of you; two days becomes one, and you tell them no chips and then eat the chips. Satan flashed that thought in the mind, because that is how temptation works: he plays on your lust. Driving by Dunkin Donuts thinking about that jelly donut, wanting the Doritos: it is literally a lust for food. When you cannot resist, the thought keeps replaying, it is something you desire that you are not supposed to have, and you give in and justify it, saying this one cookie won’t hurt, that is a lust. It is no different from pornography, adultery or fornication.

It is the exact same battle, a fleshly temptation and a worldly lust inherited through America, and the Lord is putting us on another level of discipline to show us that.

“But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection”. The whole purpose is to bring our body into subjection in our food intake and in what we take in through our eyes, “lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.”

You can control your sexual appetite and your lust through controlling your food intake. The foods you desire, the foods you are tempted with: practice abstaining from them. Alcohol is tied in the mind to late nights and social gatherings. Brothers who watch porn, try not drinking in a social environment when everyone around you is drinking. If you can abstain from that, you can abstain from anything else. You are telling your flesh and your reward centers no, disassociating the environment from the habit. Abstain from the candy you love. If you abstain from the things you love most, you gain power over everything else. Then when sexual temptation comes, you tell your body: I am not associating this feeling with pornography or with Instagram. I am going to rewire my neurons, open up a Bible, and train my brain into a new, godly habit.

Satan uses your senses as a tunnel into controlling your vessel. The eyes are the window to the soul, and your ears, your taste and your smell are windows to your vessel too. God gave the senses with a discipline behind them, the Holy Spirit which is God’s commandments: you may look, but don’t touch. If Satan gets you to look, he penetrates through the eyes and sends the signal to the hands to touch, then to the tongue to taste. That is the steps to fornication for many. Satan’s job is to nourish every sense, the eyes, ears, taste and touch, in order to fulfill your lust; God’s job is to discipline your senses. Satan calls himself a humanist and a fan of man because he nurtures every desire, and this is Satan’s world: everything in society is used to manipulate your senses and take control of your vessel to do their bidding.

“Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing”. It starts with your eyes and your mind: you see something, it hits your mind, and then you have to decide whether you will give in to that lust and feed it. “And what is created more wicked than an eye?” Desire starts first with what you see.

The good news is that you can reprogram your mind. The brain is like a computer: it takes in inputs, runs them through thought patterns, and puts out feelings and actions, and faulty patterns can be edited like code. Esau, wiser than Daniel, built the computer after the brain, its neurons and its memory storage, and social media is built to work with the brain. That is why we cannot stop scrolling: they made it an extension of you. The input devices of the brain are the senses: seeing, hearing, touching and tasting.

The computer was fashioned after the brain, to mimic the operating system the Most High gave us: the programmer inputs information to get the computer to do and think what he wants, and out comes an output. The Pharisees are dumb. They were arguing about food, about eating with unwashed hands, and Christ said, are you stupid? “Are ye also yet without understanding?”
“Whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught”.

“But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart”: what comes out of your mouth is the output, and it comes from your mind, from whatever was put into you. “And they defile the man.”

What you put in is stored, short term and long term, like RAM and a hard drive; that is why a song or a thought from years ago suddenly comes back out of you. Whoever is putting the input into your processor controls the output, and often we do not even realize we are being controlled. Those are not your words: you were made in a factory called America. The elites who control the system manipulate the education, the politics and the TV to program you to function the way they want. The only thing that breaks that code is to reprogram and recode it. Christ is the one who hacked the system and broke the code Satan encoded into the whole world, and he wiped out that virus called sin within us.

“I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?” Job had to make a covenant with his eyes: if it comes into my sight, I turn away. That is the three-second rule. You cannot control the thoughts that pop into your mind, because thoughts are living, spirits communicating through the unseen world, but you control what you do with them. Look at something more than three seconds and it is taken in as working memory; keep looking and you program it into longer-term memory. Turn away within three seconds and it does not have time to take hold.

That is why TikTok has three seconds to capture you, and why Netflix keeps it moving: the algorithm is built on how the human mind takes in information. Like a slot machine, rewards that come unpredictably keep the brain locked in anticipation and craving. The algorithm learns what makes you angry, scared, excited or curious and feeds you more of it. Your searches and scrolls are a footprint that tells who you are; Esau knows you without knowing you. But when you say the algorithm got you, it is you on that screen, a reflection of your own mind. The devil does not make you do anything you do not want to do. Our eyes are the portal to take control over our vessel.

precepts.why: “I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes”. You have to train your eyes. A show may be full of action, but as soon as something enticing comes up that goes against your values and your struggles, turn it off and click by. When you hear gossip or something negative, leave the conversation: allow three seconds of it and it will taint you; allow three seconds of a negative influence and it will control you.

sense.text:
The devil reveals his own method: I don’t make things happen; I watch; I only set the stage; you pull your own strings. Everyone has free will, and you control your destiny by the choices you make. Saying the devil made me do it is a lie; you made you do it. America is Satan’s stage, and all you do is act in the play, but you choose which script. Some of you are just wicked as hell; you got the wrong script.

“Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”. He watches you. He is seeking who is simple, who is giving him their eyes, their ears, their taste, access to their senses, so he can take control and use them.

precepts.why:
There are thoughts we have that come from spirits in an unseen realm, communicating through the mind and telling you what to think. Whether you take hold of those thoughts and act on them, or disagree and take another direction, is your choice.

“Hast not thou made an hedge about him”: God had a hedge of protection around Job. Satan said, “put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.” Stir up his life and give me the power to set the stage. “Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand.” Satan does not get you to do anything; he can take possession of your stuff and manipulate your environment as your test, but he cannot control your actions.

“So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils”. Then Job’s wife said, “Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.” Satan did not control her; he put the thought in her. In the unseen realm he had said, I can get him to curse God and die. He set the stage, created an environment to nourish his goal, and entered into the wife, because the wife is the weaker vessel. Women are weaker to their own emotions and thoughts and give in to them; men have more control over their thoughts. Satan could not get Job, so he went to the wife. She had a decision whether to act on that thought, and she chose to act on it. That is how Satan manipulates your thoughts and gets you to say words to somebody.
“The devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him”. Satan did not take hold of Judas’s hands; he put the thought in his heart, and Judas acted on that thought.

Christ told the disciples he would be betrayed and killed, and “Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.” Christ said, “Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.”

Peter had good intentions. But even when good is present, evil is there. You have to measure your intentions and weigh the words you are about to speak, filtering them through the word of God: is this God’s intention, or my own desire manipulated by the voice of Satan? Christ had to die for the sins of the nation, and Satan said through Peter, you will not allow that. Christ spotted Satan from a distance without Peter even knowing. That is how crafty and cunning Satan is: if your mind is not in tune with the scriptures, he can whisper through your thoughts and manipulate you.

sense.text:
Wisdom “goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably unto them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.” Wisdom has to meet you in every thought. When a thought comes to your mind, measure it: what is the outcome of that thought? Even with good intentions, is there an evil intention hidden in it?

In an argument, when your husband says something, the first thought may be: say this, it will trigger him, make him feel the way I feel. Those are thoughts being fed to you. What you say can bring a positive or a negative reaction, so use wisdom, filter your thoughts, and make sure they carry godly intentions.

precepts.why:
“According to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.” The power God gave us is for edification. Every thought that comes to your mind, ask: am I motivating and exhorting this person, or can the way I say it destroy them? Even a good exhortation can land negatively.

Someone may say something to you not knowing what you are going through, and it hits you wrong. Satan knows what is going on with you and used that person’s vessel; what they meant as positive comes to you as negative. Then Satan puts the thought in your mind: why would they say that, say this back, feel this way. You can respond to edification or to destruction; you can bring contention or wink at ignorance. Everything is a choice.

sense.text:
There are certain things we do that we don’t want to do. Demons do not just possess you; they need a series of yeses. Spirits inhabiting the unseen world communicate through your thoughts and set the stage, but for a demon to take full control you have to agree with the thought, make a contract, a covenant agreement with it, and act on it. If you don’t, he cannot take control of your mouth, your eyes, your ears or your tongue. As soon as a thought comes, say: I don’t agree with that, it is not according to the scriptures.

“If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” Doing well is keeping the commandments: I’m not going to watch that, eat that, touch that, taste that. That is a covenant with God. “And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door”: that is a covenant with death, a covenant with Satan, a series of yeses. Every time you disagree with keeping God’s commandments, you agree to keep Satan’s commandments, and sin is Satan’s commandments.

You slept with that person after you drank because you agreed to go over the blood alcohol level and let a spirit take control of your body. A thought came, I don’t like that sister; you agreed with it and gossiped, and now demons spread it all through the body. You know that food is not for you, but you agreed with the hunger pains, the sight and the smell of it, and now you have a gluttony spirit. Every spirit that takes possession of us does it because we made a contract with a thought and let the demon tunnel through our five senses.

precepts.why:
“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” If you are constantly walking in the spirit, keeping yourself in check with a strong unit of brothers like Captain Yan and Captain Zev, studying, watching classes at the feet of the bishop and the deacons, addicting yourself to God’s word, you don’t have time to entertain the flesh. You are not watching Netflix four or five hours, or anything not nourishing to your spirit.

Some from the streets have not changed because the music they listen to has not changed, and the scriptures have not manifested through their ears and eyes. You lust because you always watch things that cause you to lust. You have to reprogram and rewire your brain to develop godly habits, addict yourself to the word, and control your senses: what you hear, see, taste and smell. “For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”.

sense.text: “Master, eat.” The disciples were trying to tell Christ what to do.

“I have meat to eat that ye know not of.” Christ could easily have said yes, but he showed he was in complete control of his own vessel, his actions, his mission and his goals. Nobody could program Christ but the Father, whose Holy Spirit inhabited his vessel from birth. He was the master of his own sight, smell, taste and hearing, the ruler of his own thoughts, the programmer of his own operating system.
“Hath any man brought him ought to eat?” They thought he needed to eat.

“My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.” Not fleshly temptations and earthly desires: Christ had complete control over the things you need for life and to nourish life. He did not have a wife; he resisted those things and had complete control over his senses. That was his meat, his existence, his food, his thought, his vessel, his senses, the reason he was born on this earth, so that nobody could control or program him.

That should be all of our agendas: our meat is to do the will of the Father, to consume the scriptures, to see, taste, hear and believe the scriptures. This is our meat, our nourishment, our life.
